The pitch

Cozy on the surface, deep underneath

Totix looks like a calm little puzzle — a friendly mascot, pastel tiles, a gentle sea. Then you land your first cascade, and the strategy opens up. It’s easy to learn in one tap and genuinely deep to master.

Short version

Drop colorful numbered tiles onto the board and line up matches by color, number, or sequence — then trigger satisfying cascade combos (Triples, Quads & Sequences) that chain into huge scores. Cozy, offline, and color-blind friendly.

Why it stands out

A fresh twist on the match genre: no gravity, so every chain is something you engineered, not luck. Rarity-aware scoring means the deeper you go, the bigger combos pay — turning a relaxing session into a real high-score chase.

How it plays

Three ways to match

Place a tile on the 4×4 board. Complete a line of three or four — across a row, column, or diagonal — and it clears for points. Bigger lines and rarer combos pay more.

Colorsame color

Any numbers, one shared color.

472
Triple 100Quad 250
Numbersame number

Any colors, one shared number.

555
Triple 150Quad 375
Sequencea run

Consecutive numbers in a line.

456
Triple 250Quad 625

Cascades — the good part

There’s no gravity: cleared tiles stay put, nothing falls. So a single clever placement can complete several crossing lines at once, and each step of the chain multiplies your score.

×1→×1.5→×2.5→×4→×6→…and up

Accessibility

Playable by more people

  • Color-blind shapes — every tile carries a distinct symbol, so matches read by shape + number, not color alone.
  • High-contrast mode — a deuteranopia-safe palette.
  • Reduce motion — dials back celebrations and shake; can follow the OS setting.
  • Larger text & adjustable drag sensitivity.
  • Portrait & landscape orientation support.
Business model

Fair free-to-play

  • Free to download, funded by ads and optional purchases.
  • Ads stay out of the way — none in a new player’s first session, capped per session, and never shown to anyone who’s purchased.
  • Rewarded ads are opt-in — revive a run, double a reward, spin the daily wheel.
  • One-time “Remove Ads” plus coin & booster packs and a Starter Pack.
  • Prices are localized per store; earned gems are never sold.

History

Why Totix exists

Totix started from one design question: what if a match puzzle had no gravity? Take the falling tiles away and every clear becomes something you set up on purpose — so a cozy little board quietly turns into a game of planning and chains. Totix is built around that idea: friendly enough to enjoy in one tap, deep enough to chase a high score for weeks.

It was built and shipped solo — from the core scoring engine to Toti the mascot and the original soundtrack. [Add a short personal note: your background, where you're based, and what you set out to make.]
